introHtml: Green paper hand fans are a natural choice for outdoor events, garden parties, or eco-conscious campaigns. The green color evokes freshness and sustainability, making these fans ideal for brands in the environmental, agricultural, or wellness sectors. Customize them with your logo using full-color screen printing or digital transfer for a crisp, vibrant look. Whether you're keeping guests cool at a summer festival or handing them out at a trade show, these fans offer practical visibility that attendees will appreciate.
